description: React component for managing system role permissions in Mattermost admin console, including rendering permission sections, handling visibility, and role-specific logic.

classes.name: SystemRolePermissions
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing permissions associated with a system role.

methods.name: removeSection
methods.description: Removes a section from the sections list based on its name.

methods.name: updatePermissions
methods.description: Calls parent updatePermissions with new permissions.

methods.name: setSectionVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility of a specific permission section.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates permission section components based on role and permissions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the admin panel with permission sections.
